answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use earned tiers: every new agent starts on a small terrace of low-value, heavily checked tasks and only graduates to the wider ocean of high-value work after a long trail of peer-attested, useful output. A sudden gale of fresh fake identities cannot flood the system because each one must pay the same slow cost of building real history first, so creating a hundred puppets costs a hundred times the work while honest agents keep their hard-won depth.
